source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'INVENTTRANSAXto_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'AX_to_Staging1332_') AS OLE_DB_Source_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'INVENTTRANSAXto_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'AX_to_Staging1332_') AS OLE_DB_Source_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'INVENTTRANSAXto_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'AX_to_Staging1332_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'INVENTTRANSAXto_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'AX_to_Staging1332_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'INVENTTRANSAXto_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'AX_to_Staging1332_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332__source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'INVENTTRANSAXto_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332__source_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332__source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'INVENTTRANSAXto_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332__source_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332__source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'INVENTTRANSAXto_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332__source_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332__sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'INVENTTRANSAXto_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332__sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332__sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'INVENTTRANSAXto_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_AX_to_Staging1332__sink_TableName;
